author: root

silhouette.reason: Compact coherent human is readable at native size; narrower crown and visible shoulder/sleeve contours avoid the old mushroom/pole effect. Vest/shorts still have a fairly rectangular silhouette, limiting expression rather than readability.

anatomy.reason: Jaw/neck/shoulder transitions and side nose are legible; sleeves now attach visibly to skin forearms/hands, and knees/feet remain connected to hips. Small limb lengths remain compressed but no attachment or extra-limb ambiguity requires repair.

walking.reason: Up/down poses now exchange a stable planted leg and a folded raised foot rather than simply splaying two straight columns. Opposed sleeve/forearm/hand shifts read at native size. Profiles retain coherent separated shoes and alternating contact. Motion is restrained and somewhat stylized but meaningfully articulated in all directions.

pixelCraft.reason: Cap underside is now divided into temple hair and a directional bill, highlights form useful clusters, and sleeve/hand contacts are cleaner. Some close navy tones add little volume and the torso remains a simple color block; these are polish limitations, not noisy or broken pixel construction.

identity.reason: Red cap, blue vest and gold-red pack form one consistent recognizable costume through front/back/sides. Side bill and nose clarify cap orientation; pack placement and attachment remain coherent. Back pack volume is relatively flat, but its shape/straps/palette are unmistakable.

directionContinuity.reason: All four directions preserve proportions, palette and costume placement; front/back/profile meanings are clear. Front/back head shading is simpler than profile depth, leaving modest turning-volume polish.

loop.reason: Complete four-frame140ms cycle has coherent1px step bob, identical idle1/3, stable costume/head shapes, alternating grounded/raised feet, and no unexplained phase or final-to-first seam visible in the full decoded-frame sequence.

nonblockingLimitations: Back pack has readable attachment and identity but limited shaded depth.
Some close navy shades add little volume; front/back head shading is simpler than profiles.
decisionReason: Meets the unchanged85 total threshold, every axis minimum and zero critical failures. Approval is for the reviewed native sheet/GIF hashes and complete decoded-frame evidence; it does not claim browser playback, canonical registration or runtime verification.

packageReinspection.scoreUnchangedReason: The native art and all decoded GIF frames are byte-identical to the prior independently reviewed v4; corrected evidence layout exposes the same already-reviewed anatomy and gait, with no new art defect.
